record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, construct a fixed history-input feature from training-only item counts: scale each real item's existing input embedding by 1-0.1*log1p(count_i)/log1p(max_count). Keep padding zero and candidate embeddings unchanged. This modest attenuation may reduce frequent items' dominance in recurrent updates without adding a scorer or learned embedding parameters. Save training counts with each model and update the predictor writer to reproduce the feature. Preserve GRU topology, readout, loss, optimizer and sampling.
